title: Frozen stability margin after resistive load shedding: data and code
description: Public mirror of Supplementary Material S1 of the manuscript on the decision-induced bias of frozen small-signal margins after resistive load shedding in islanded grid-forming microgrids with constant power loads (submitted to Sustainable Energy, Grids and Networks). Contains the model and test code, sealed outputs with hash lists, post-hoc analyses, the development_20261026 addition and the p92_20261026 addition (Newton-kappa estimator, current-limit stress, ramped shedding, kappa-triggered relinearization, learned baseline, switching-level checks). See README.md and SHA256SUMS.
